case.title: Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14
case.author: Air Technical Intelligence Center, United States Air Force
case.provenance: Owner-supplied CIA-UAP-015 release copy. Official PURSUE publisher page identifies Release 03 (June 12, 2026); indexed official PDF URL identifies this exact filename.
case.rightsBasis: Government report; physical page 4 states no copyright material is contained in the publication. Source unchanged; PDF copy permissions are a separate technical constraint.

rightsClearance.scope: Government-publication provenance recorded for development; no new owner-confirmed rights determination or shipped-catalog admission.

case.reviewStatus: Inspecting default refusal and warning behavior; no fidelity qualification.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; resource regression ceiling, not quality approval or a mobile device budget

qualityExpectation.basis: Inspected typewritten and handwritten table pages need explicit complexity/fallback signaling, not merely imageRegion or furnitureRemoved. No current quality-refusal error exists; approved diagnostics remain empty until an explicit API contract is implemented. A future dedicated unreliable-text warning can be added when defined.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
